title: 八旬富豪押上404亿：帮儿子竞购华纳兄弟，甲骨文家族财富版图会怎么变？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: There's a quote that actually is generally thought to come from Genghis Khan, but Larry Alicin says so much that folks often attribute it to him.
segments.zh: 有句话通常被认为出自成吉思汗，但拉里·埃里森经常引用，所以常被误认为是他说的。

segments.en: It's not enough that I win. Everybody else has to lose.
segments.zh: 我赢还不够，其他人都得输。

segments.en: Why might Alicin see something of himself in a 13th century Mongol warlord obsessed with Eurasian land acquisition?
segments.zh: 为什么埃里森会从一个痴迷于欧亚大陆扩张的13世纪蒙古军阀身上看到自己的影子？

segments.en: Well, there's the immense power and wealth.
segments.zh: 嗯，有巨大的权力和财富。

segments.en: Alicin is one of the world's richest people. My personality is not going to be a quit one winning.
segments.zh: 埃里森是全球最富有的人之一。我的个性不会甘于平庸。

segments.en: The thrill of eviscerating rivals. Oracle clinches the deal to buy people's off.
segments.zh: 击败对手的快感。甲骨文敲定收购PeopleSoft的交易。

segments.en: When it all costs, that's kind of the lesson that many have taken from him.
segments.zh: 不惜一切代价，这就是许多人从他身上学到的教训。

segments.en: The lure of spearheading a dynasty. Larry Alicin is throwing his personal fortune behind Paramount's bid for Warner Brothers.
segments.zh: 引领王朝的诱惑。拉里·埃里森正将个人财富投入派拉蒙对华纳兄弟的竞购。

segments.en: Larry Alicin is basically helping his son, David Alicin. It could dramatically reshape the Oracle family's fortune.
segments.zh: 拉里·埃里森基本上是在帮助他的儿子大卫·埃里森。这可能极大重塑甲骨文家族的财富。

segments.en: Then there's the actual empire itself. Oracle.
segments.zh: 然后还有实际的帝国本身：甲骨文。

segments.en: Oracle. The company and its founder are practically synonymous, though their public image could hardly be more opposite.
segments.zh: 甲骨文。公司和创始人几乎融为一体，但公众形象却截然相反。

segments.en: One's a stylish life in the fast lane optogenarian who owns a rhinoceros and the other.
segments.zh: 一位是时尚、快节奏生活的老年富豪，还养着一头犀牛；另一位则是……

segments.en: It's a database and data center company.
segments.zh: 一家数据库和数据中心公司。

segments.en: Sounds a bit dull. Oracle built ways to keep track of your workforce, your supply chain, your financials.
segments.zh: 听起来有点乏味。甲骨文打造了追踪员工、供应链和财务的方法。

segments.en: Still sounds a bit dull. Come on.
